Package Summary
Package
Description
io.webagent4j.action
Verified browser actions: one explicit, bounded command pipeline per interaction, with three terminal modes - real execution, dryRun(), and plan() - that all share the exact same target-resolution and precondition logic so they can never disagree.
io.webagent4j.action.internal
 
io.webagent4j.action.policy
Action authorization: IActionPolicy governs whether one action's backend side effect may proceed, evaluated by the action pipeline strictly before the backend is ever invoked.
io.webagent4j.browser
Backend-neutral browser, page, and frame contracts - no Playwright (or other native backend) type appears in any public signature here.
io.webagent4j.browser.playwright
 
io.webagent4j.browsercrawler
A deterministic, bounded-concurrency browser crawler: JavaScript-rendered link discovery through a real browser session, reusing webagent4j-browser-api for navigation and webagent4j-wait for stability rather than a second wait/timing implementation.
io.webagent4j.browsercrawler.internal
Engine internals for BrowserCrawler: the FIFO frontier, the synchronized claim gate, scope evaluation, DOM link discovery, page stability waiting, and URL normalization.
io.webagent4j.cli
 
io.webagent4j.common
 
io.webagent4j.core
WebAgent4J's public facade: the entry point application code starts from.
io.webagent4j.crawler
The deterministic, sequential HTTP crawler engine: a java.net.http.HttpClient fetcher, jsoup link extraction, a breadth-first frontier, URL normalization/deduplication/scope policy, and redirect/retry handling - no browser, no JavaScript execution.
io.webagent4j.crawler.api
Backend-neutral HTTP crawler contracts - depends only on webagent4j-common: no HTTP client, no HTML parser, no Playwright.
io.webagent4j.crawler.internal
 
io.webagent4j.dom
The backend-neutral live-element vocabulary shared by the locator, action, extraction, and observation subsystems - depends only on immutable, backend-neutral contracts.
io.webagent4j.examples
 
io.webagent4j.extraction
 
io.webagent4j.extraction.api
Backend-neutral extraction request/result/provenance contracts, converters, validators, and the extraction-specific failure taxonomy - depends only on webagent4j-locator-api, never on webagent4j-dom.
io.webagent4j.integration.coverage
 
io.webagent4j.locator
 
io.webagent4j.locator.api
Immutable, backend-neutral locator definitions and the fluent query contracts every semantic search builds on - IFind and ILocator contain no engine logic and no backend-native type.
io.webagent4j.locator.internal
 
io.webagent4j.observation
The immutable semantic observation model, options, renderers, diff, fingerprint, and the batch-capture backend SPI (io.webagent4j.observation.spi) - depends on webagent4j-dom and webagent4j-locator-api only, never on a browser backend.
io.webagent4j.observation.internal
 
io.webagent4j.observation.spi
 
io.webagent4j.plugin
 
io.webagent4j.policy
Generic, synchronous execution-policy contracts shared across WebAgent4J modules.
io.webagent4j.policy.network
Network-destination governance: INetworkPolicy decides whether WebAgent4J may make a network request to a given destination, evaluated strictly before the request is sent.
io.webagent4j.recording
 
io.webagent4j.verification
Deterministic, side-effect-free, pollable conditions over current page state - used both as action postconditions (IPreparedAction#expect(...)) and standalone.
io.webagent4j.wait
The one deterministic polling/deadline primitive shared by locator resolution, verification polling, and action stabilization - not three independent timers.
io.webagent4j.workflow
Deterministic, sequential workflow orchestration over the existing action pipeline: typed variables, masked secret inputs and outputs, small declarative conditions, and structured fail-fast results.
